## Summary of how each finding was addressed

**Finding #1 (high, correctness — `--all` ≠ configured targets)**: Removed the SpinDine entry from `default_showcase_config()` and deleted the `DEFAULT_TARGETS_FOR_ALL` allowlist constant entirely (`scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/showcase/config.py`). `filter_targets()` now returns every entry in the config list when no `--target` is passed (`scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/showcase/generator.py:464-484`). The v0 default config is exactly the 4 targets D002 picked: dontpanic, agent-conventions, axiom, glam. Added `test_filter_targets_all_flag_returns_every_configured_target` to lock the invariant.

**Finding #2 (high, correctness — untracked implementation)**: Committed the entire showcase surface in `7937975` — package (`__init__.py`, `config.py`, `generator.py`, `redactor.py`), both new test modules, three modified existing files (`dontpanic_doctor.py`, `cli.py`, `sanitization_check.py`), all 11 generated artifact files under `docs/showcase/`, and the plan's round-state files (INBOX, audit/, evidence/). `git ls-files` will now see them.

**Finding #3 (medium, correctness — `DEFAULT_SHOWCASE_CONFIG` missing)**: Added `DEFAULT_SHOWCASE_CONFIG: list[TargetSpec] = default_showcase_config()` as a module-level constant in `config.py` and
